subject.title: [Feature]: Include interaction metadata in Discord button callbacks

question: Should generic Discord component callbacks expose a documented structured interaction metadata envelope to agents, or should rich interaction fields remain plugin-handler-only?
rationale: The requested change would create a public inbound-context contract and expose Discord identifiers plus callback data, so automation should not choose the schema or trust boundary on its own.

options.title: Add Typed Agent Metadata
options.body: Expose a bounded, documented metadata envelope with source message id, component kind, safe callback/custom data, label/value details, and clicker identity, backed by Discord plugin tests.

options.title: Keep Metadata Plugin-Only
options.body: Leave rich interaction fields on plugin interactive handlers and document that stateful Discord workflows should use plugin callbacks rather than generic fallback messages.

options.title: Expose Minimal IDs First
options.body: Expose only clicker and source message identifiers now, then defer callback payload semantics until a broader inbound metadata contract is settled.

recommendation.title: Add Typed Agent Metadata
recommendation.body: Expose a bounded, documented metadata envelope with source message id, component kind, safe callback/custom data, label/value details, and clicker identity, backed by Discord plugin tests.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice is primarily a public contract and plugin-boundary decision, and steipete has recent adjacent Discord component and metadata merge history.
